_note: Total coverage on paper, seven of ten requirements standing in for a
measurement nobody made. Above MAX_ASSUMED_FRACTION the twin is no longer
reporting a measurement, it is reporting its own priors, and a verdict
from it would look exactly like one built on data.
Routes to: refuse, or sweep every assumption and report the range rather
than a number - never a point verdict.
This is the one fixture where a field other than the reason matters: the
route depends on COUNTING assumed provenances, and on each of them
carrying a plausible_range. It still never reads a value.
Every tier-1 value below is the real fit from refute/calibration.py,
relabelled. That is deliberate: the fixture shows that provenance, not
plausibility, is what the gate must route on.
Total over both requirement sets, per the convention in full_coverage.json,
and tier 0 is deliberately short of the two quantities it cannot be given.
alpha and n_per_arm are supplied because they are genuinely available - a
threshold and a well count, neither of them a measurement. effect_size and
within_arm_sd are blocked, so the fallback does not open and the route
stays REFUSE, which is what this fixture is for: a twin made mostly of
stand-ins is refused on its own account, not rescued by arithmetic. Supply
those two and the route becomes tier 0, at which point this file stops
testing the assumed-fraction rule and duplicates tier1_gaps_tier0_ok.
Blocked ASSAY_SPECIFIC for the reason set out in all_blocked.json: a
within-arm SD in this rig's fill-points transfers nowhere, and no corpus
prints either quantity, so NOT_REPORTED would assert a search that could
not have been run.
